name: label
title: Label
description: A label component with asterisk indicator, sub-text, and info icon. Uses namespace exports: Label.Root, Label.Asterisk, Label.Sub, Label.InfoIcon.

migration.guide: v3 adds `Label.InfoIcon` — a built-in info circle SVG icon with default `size-5 text-text-disabled-300` styling. Override size/color via className. No breaking changes from v2.

docs.lead: A label component with required asterisk indicator and optional sub-text for form inputs.
docs.usage:
import * as Label from "@/components/ui/label"

<Label.Root>
  Field Name
  <Label.Asterisk />
  <Label.Sub>(Optional)</Label.Sub>
  <Label.Info>Helpful tooltip text</Label.Info>
</Label.Root>

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Label with asterisk, sub-text, and info icon.

api.name: Label.Root
api.description: The root label element built on Radix Label.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the label and apply disabled styling to all children

api.name: Label.Asterisk
api.description: Required field asterisk indicator in primary color.

api.name: Label.Sub
api.description: Secondary text displayed after the label.

api.name: Label.InfoIcon
api.description: Standalone info circle SVG icon with default size-5 and text-text-disabled-300 color. Override via className.

api.name: Label.Info
api.description: Info icon wrapped in a tooltip. Pass tooltip text as children.
